The area named Vindict residing on the moon of Utril is known for its extremely hazardous infestation of White mold. It is recommended to stay clear from this area. The I.T.D.A. has decided to contain it rather than attempt clearing it. Visit at your own risk. Medical equipment remains inside.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Executed.

CONDITIONS: Bright, dry terrain, poisonous atmosphere with high mold density.

FAUNA: FAUNA: A flawed ecosystem, home to Lacerta-glomerorum, dominated by arachnids.

> Environment

Vindict is a hilly and grassy moon with bridges to get across a valley. It has several small and large twisted tree formations. The flora consisting of Pyntrus Lotuses, tall bushes and grass, and other dead trees has been completely overrun by the white mold and has a white coloration to it. Eight sets of strange red eggs can also be found scattered around the exterior.

Three concrete buildings can be found on the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is atop a hill and is visible northwest of the ship. Both fire exits are to the left and right respectively in the valley behind and west of the ship.

Exterior Ambience

Interior Ambience

> Weather

Vindict supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, and Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Mold Spikes

Vindict's exterior has spikes of white mold on the that will continously and rapidly deal 4 damage to any player that gets in close proximity of them.

Vindict's interior has similar spikes, but they only pulse once and deal 10 damage. They can hit a player twice if a player moves back into the spike during a pulse animation. Mold is also abundant in the interior and can greatly hinder visibility.

Cache

In the valley behind and west of the ship is a Databox and Cache. This Cache will always spawn a Recovery order and will additionally spawn up to six random items from a pool of Cables, Circuit boards, Copper wiring, Lithium, Steel ingots, and at a much lower chance Triangulation devices. The Cache will reroll its generated items with each landing, so players can leave and return to Vindict if they dislike the items on it. However, as soon as any player gets too close to the Cache it will only spawn the Recovery order on future landings on that save file.

Utril and Mysterious Altars

If a Brooding seed was placed on the altar on the exterior of Utril, the terrain on the exterior will be dramatically altered, several tentacles will appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, the interior will be visually altered, and an Assimilated Growth will almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on Vindict in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, and Gloom, in which case these changes become permanent on that save file.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging the Recovery order that can be found on the exteriors of Glace, Selector, or Trite. Alternatively, inserting the Vindict videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Utril into the projector on Galetry.

Unlocks

ResearcherxB: The guaranteed and recommended first location to place a Triangulation device.

> Lore

Takeoff

Text ⁠
Transcript security recording - Day 14 
------------------------ 15:12 - Cargo dock

C. Darter: That’s everything in cargo?
S. Dent: Just about, yeah.
C. Darter: Good, I’ll signal Julian so he can start the engines.
S. Dent: He knows how to fly this thing? I thought he was only here in case things like.. that.. Jump out on us.
C. Darter: He doesn’t need to know how to fly, the autopilot takes care of that. He only needs to power the engines and make sure nothing goes up in flames in the process.
S. Dent: oh, I assumed there was some manual labour involved in the taking off part but that makes sense. Well I’ll be in the office on Level 2 documenting our discoveries.
C. Darter: Alright.

------------------------ 17:20 - Central hallway

S. Dent: Hey, is everything in order?
J. Charter: I have nothing to report on, there hasn’t been a breach of containment.
S. Dent: That’s good.
J. Charter: Sorry for asking but, what is that stuff we collected?
S. Dent: It’s a type of Eumycota.. or fungi in layman's terms, a white mold that seems to form these spike-like pustules which it uses to inject itself into any unfortunate creature that happens to step on it.
J. Charter: I see. So that’s what was wrong with that spider.
S. Dent: Yeah, so don’t touch the mold.
J. Charter: What are you planning on doing with it?
S. Dent: That is classified.
J. Charter: Understood.
S. Dent: I’ve got some work to do so I’ll be off.
J. Okay. Stay safe.

------------------------ 22:43 - Communications

S. Underhill: What’s the status.
C. Darter: We have contained some new samples for the project.
S. Underhill: Is it promising?
C. Darter: ..Potentially, I have not conducted extensive research just yet.
S. Underhill: That will be your priority from now on.
C. Darter: Of course. As you wish.
S. Underhill: I sense that you are displeased. Is there anything I should know about?
C. Darter: It doesn’t feel right. It’s immoral. We shouldn’t build a future on the torture of innocents.
S. Underhill: If the loss of innocent lives worries you then I would recommend reminding yourself that our sins are as many as the others.
C. Darter: It isn’t right.
S. Underhill: Perhaps you don’t understand.
C. Darter: Understand what? The fact that innocent people are being cut to pieces for an opportunity of finding someone who we then also torture with the notion of it will help build our future? You mean that?
S. Underhill: We have our projects, our corporations, people, governments, ideologies, politics, empires.. together it forms a society.. The people strive to climb higher, rule, gain control, to sit at the top of whatever they feel gives them power, yet even when they get there, they still feel it.. that entity looming over their shoulder from a step on the ladder too high for anyone to reach. They hide behind the facade of smaller corporations. You know their influence. They allow us to exist as long as we provide, no matter the methods or the cost. If they won't care, why should we.
C. Darter: The.. entity?
S. Underhill: I expect a report tomorrow before the end of the day. Otherwise you will be considered for repurposing.
C. Darter: ..Understood.

Vindict Videotape

This videotape can only be found as random scrap within the interior of Utril.

Text ⁠
I would not recommend visiting this area. Whereas our side of Utril is primarily dark.
The zone we named Vindict is much more exposed to the sun.

Utril has an infestation of white mold. Fortunately for us it cannot grow in the dark but it thrives in the sun. This mold can sense when something is close and will not hesitate to sting you. Once it stings a creature, it infects it and starts growing within it until it eventually dies allowing it to settle in a new location.
Vindict is covered in it.

It's everywhere.

Professor Harrington, over and out.
